system.description:
Lore: Relic Pearl (Bound)

Sealed in an ancient tomb beneath Good Mead, alongside somebody who clearly wanted it kept there. It has the following Powers:

  • Recall: Once per Rest, regain Mana equal to a Spell you have already Cast.

Value: 5000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
